info.title: GMD API v3.0 Beta
info.description: Gracenote Global Music Data (GMD) API V3.0 **Beta** Specification. Interfaces are subject to change.

tags.name: Artists
tags.description:
Artist in GMD is a recording artist with a unique identity and billing.
An Artist may be an individual, group, ensemble, or collaboration of any of these.
An Artist creates Recordings.
Recordings are then released as Album Tracks on one or more Albums Editions.

tags.name: Recordings
tags.description:
Recording in GMD is a perceptually unique audio Recording.
Various individual Album Track instances that have been released of the same
Recording are identified as perceptually identical by comparing metadata and
acoustic fingerprints. All such Album Track instances map to the same Recording ID
and descriptive profile.

tags.name: AlbumEditions
tags.description:
An Album Edition is a specific Edition of an Album Master - comprised of a unique
configuration of Recordings.

tags.name: AlbumMasters
tags.description:
An Album Master groups all known Album Editions for a given logical release and
provides a single, canonical view across those editions.

Think of it as a "parent" that holds together the remastered version, the deluxe
edition, regional variants, etc. — so you can show one clean entry per album
in a discography instead of listing every re-release separately.

Each Album Master has a `preferredEditionID` (the best-fit edition picked by
Gracenote's algorithms) and an `allAlbumEditions` array with every known variant.

**How it fits together:**
Artist → Album Master → Album Editions → Tracks → Recordings

**Good to know:**
- Only the `/albumMasters/explore` endpoint exists — there is no lookup or search.
- If you need a specific master, filter by `artistIDs` and page through results,
  or grab an Album Edition via `/albumEditions/lookup` and work backwards from there.

tags.name: Entitlements
tags.description:
Entitlements represent authorization levels, determining the specific data access granted 
to a user based on their API key. All valid API keys are provisioned with the 'base' package at least. 
API keys may have additional packages and addOns assigned to them, granting extended functionality.

tags.name: DescriptorCorrelations
tags.description:
The descriptor correlation request enables the computation of Artist and Recording
similarity by providing numerical values representing similarity or dissimilarity.
These values can be used to inform music discovery and catalog navigation models
and algorithms.

tags.name: DescriptorHierarchies
tags.description:
Descriptor hierarchies provide structured access to Gracenote's comprehensive taxonomies of musical 
descriptors including GENRES, LANGUAGES, ORIGINS, ERAS, ARTISTTYPES, MOODS, STYLES, and TEMPOS. Each hierarchy contains 
organized, multi-level categorical data with parent-child relationships that can be used for discovery of the music catalog.

get.description: Text search for `Artist` objects using artist name.

Get `Artist` object(s) by ID

**Notes**
* Objects are returned in order requested.
* Only one object is returned per ID. *if the input ID matches multiple objects, only one will be returned.*
* If an object is not found, a 404 is returned along with a message indicating which ID wasn't found.
* Duplicate ids in the query will result in a 400 response.
* GN TMS Person ID lookups require GN TMS Person ID add-on.

**Example:** Lookup by Gracenote ID

`https://.../artists/lookup?ids=GND6CJFDB6BH1X3&idType=artistID`

**Example:** Lookup by  personID

`https://.../artists/lookup?ids=521029&idType=personID`

Get `Artist` object(s) - optionally filtered and sorted.

Without any query parameters, the `explore` Artists endpoint will return the most highly consumed artists Globally over the past year. Additional parameters including Gracenote Descriptors such as genres and origins can be added as parameters to further filter the set of retrievable artists.

***Note: You can add an `artistID` filter parameter to allow using `includeRelatedArtists` to return artists that are related to the seed artist. Use `omitSeedArtists` to not include the seed Artist in the result set.***

**Example:** Explore popular artists

`https://.../artists/explore`"

Text search `Recording` objects using recording name and or artist name.

**Note** that one of either recording or artist name is required.

Due to ISRC consistency issues (e.g., duplicate or incorrect ISRC), ISRC matching is a lower priority than the other inputs.

Get `Recording` object(s) by ID

**Notes**
* Objects are returned in order requested.
* Only one object is returned per ID. *so if the input ID matches multiple objects, only one will be returned.*
* If an object is not found, a 404 is returned along with a message indicating which ID wasn't found.
* Duplicate ids in the query will result in a 400 response.

**Example:** Lookup by Gracenote recording ID

`https://.../recordings/lookup?ids=GN0TR5Z86C868HS&idType=recordingID`

**Example:** Lookup by ISRC

`https://.../recordings/lookup?ids=DEY371001140&idType=isrc`

Get `Recording` object(s) - optionally filtered and sorted.

Without any query parameters, the `explore` Recordings endpoint will return the most highly consumed recordings Globally over the past year.

***Note: When adding an `artistID` filter parameter, the best practice is to set `includeRelatedArtists` to include `memberOfKeyArtists` and `memberOfCollaborations`. This will ensure a complete set of recordings for the given artist.***

**Example:** Explore recordings by an artist

`https://.../recordings/explore?artistIDs=GMGZZX800003Y64&includeRelatedArtists=memberOfKeyArtists,memberOfCollaborations`

Text search `AlbumEdition` objects using album edition name and artist name.


**Note** that both albumEditionName and artistName are required inputs.

Get `AlbumEdition` object(s) by ID

**Notes**
* Objects are returned in order requested.
* Only one object is returned per ID. *so if the input ID matches multiple objects, only one will be returned.*
* If an object is not found, a 404 is returned along with a message indicating which ID wasn't found.
* Duplicate ids in the query will result in a 400 response.

**Example:** Lookup by Gracenote ID

`https://.../albumEditions/lookup?ids=GN949Y7H6M9XNYP&idType=albumEditionID`

Get `Album Edition` object(s) - optionally filtered and sorted.

Without any query parameters, the `explore` Album Editions endpoint will return a set of recent Album Editions to the end user.

When filtering by `artistID`, we would suggest as a best practice to sort by `releaseYear` and filter on `mainCanon` release types.

***Note: Filter by genreIDs is not yet supported.***

**Example:** Explore main canon editions by an artist, sorted descending by release year

`https://.../albumEditions/artistIDs=GMGZZX800003Y64&releaseTypes=mainCanon&sort=-releaseYear`

Returns Album Master objects — one per logical album — so you can build a
discography without worrying about duplicate editions.

You must supply at least one filter: `artistIDs`, `tmsIDs`, or
`videoMusicReleaseType`. Combine them if you like; when more than one is
present they're ANDed together.

If you don't pass a `sort` parameter, results come back in newest-first
(descending release year) order.

There's no lookup or search for Album Masters. If you already have an
Album Edition ID, use `/albumEditions/lookup` and work from there instead.

**Example:** Get an artist's albums, newest first
`https://.../albumMasters/explore?artistIDs=GMGZZX800003Y64&sort=-releaseYear`

**Example:** Find soundtracks tied to a TMS program
`https://.../albumMasters/explore?tmsIDs=12345&videoMusicReleaseType=soundtrack`

**Example:** Only main canon albums for an artist
`https://.../albumMasters/explore?artistIDs=GMGZZX800003Y64&releaseTypes=mainCanon`
Lookup Entitlements licensed to the user's API Key. The API Key mentioned in the Request Header will be used to fetch its related entitlements.

The descriptor correlation API enables the computation of Artist and Recording similarity by providing numerical values representing that similarity.  These similarity values can be used to inform music discovery and catalog navigation models and algorithms.

The following workflow illustrates how correlates are used to show that the genre **Psychedelic Rock** is more similar to **Post-Modern Rock** than it is to **Ragtime**.

1. The leaf genreID for \"Psychedelic Rock\" is `2844`.
2. The `/descriptors/descriptorCorrelations` API is used with `genreID` value `2844`
```
curl https://<url>/descriptorCorrelations/lookup?idType=genreID&ids=2844
  ...
  {
    {
      "descriptorID": "33121",
      "label": "Post-Modern Rock",
      "weight": "200"
    },
    {
      "descriptorID": "3128",
      "label": "Ragtime",
      "weight": "-700"
    }
    ...
  }
  ```

  3. The results show that **Post-Modern Rock** is correlated to **Psychedelic Rock** with a weight of **200** while **Ragtime** is correlated with weight of **-700**.  Therefore, **Post-Modern Rock** is the most similar genre.

Get structured descriptor hierarchy data for Gracenote's music descriptor taxonomies.

Supports 17 different genre hierarchies (regional and complexity variants) plus additional descriptor types including LANGUAGES, ORIGINS, ERAS, ARTISTTYPES, MOODS, STYLES, and TEMPOS. 
The endpoint returns organized, multi-level categorical data that can be filtered by specific levels.

**Example:** Get full GENRES-US-SIMPLIFIED hierarchy

`https://.../descriptorHierarchy/lookup?descriptorList=GENRES-US-SIMPLIFIED`

**Example:** Get only level 2 data from ORIGINS hierarchy

`https://.../descriptorHierarchy/lookup?descriptorList=ORIGINS&level=2`

**Note:** The API returns different data based on query parameters: full hierarchy requests include projected nodes for continuity, while level-specific queries return only authentic nodes, excluding projected entries. The lowest hierarchy level contains entries with English-only labels. Future development plans may include localization, which is currently not yet complete.

idTypeRecordings.name: idType

idTypeAlbumEditions.name: idType
idTypeAlbumEditions.description: Type of the IDs specified in the 'ids' parameter. For externalID lookups, use the `source` value of the associated ID for the `type` parameter.

sortArtists.name: sort
sortArtists.description: Sort criteria for Artist results. A prefix of '-' means sort descending. Sorting by ascending popularity score is not supported.

sortRecordings.name: sort
sortRecordings.description: Sort criteria for Recording results. A prefix of '-' means sort descending. Sorting by ascending popularity score is not supported.

videoQuality.name: videoQuality
videoQuality.description: Comma-separated list of YouTube video quality values for filtering results. Accepted values are hd and sd (case-insensitive). Duplicate values are not allowed. Use hd,sd to return recordings with any linked YouTube video of HD or SD quality. Requires youtube-video-id add-on.

videoType.name: videoType
videoType.description: Filter recordings by YouTube video type (e.g. vevo). Requires youtube-video-id add-on.

sortAlbumEditions.name: sort
sortAlbumEditions.description:
Sort criteria for Album Edition results. A prefix of '-' means sort descending.
Sorting by `releaseType` uses this ordering: mainCanon, mainCanonCollection, singleEP, singleArtistCollection, artistCollection

sortAlbumMasters.name: sort
sortAlbumMasters.description:
How to order the results. Prefix with `-` for descending.

Leave this out and you'll get newest albums first (descending release year).

When sorting by `releaseType`, the order is:
mainCanon → mainCanonCollection → singleEP → singleArtistCollection →
multiArtistCollection → unclassified.

Albums without a `releaseYear` end up at the bottom when you sort by year.

includeAllEditions.name: includeAllEditions
includeAllEditions.description: If set to true, all editions of the album(s) will be returned. By default, only the selected album edition is returned.

popularityRegion.name: popularityRegion
popularityRegion.description: If sorting or filtering by popularity, which region's popularity to use. Use 'Global' or two letter code for the region.

genreIDs.name: genreIDs
genreIDs.description: Comma separated list of Gracenote genre descriptorIDs for filtering results (max 5)

eraIDs.name: eraIDs
eraIDs.description: Comma separated list of Gracenote era descriptorIDs for filtering results (max 5)

originIDs.name: originIDs
originIDs.description: Comma separated list of Gracenote origin descriptorIDs for filtering results (max 5)

artistTypeIDs.name: artistTypeIDs
artistTypeIDs.description: Comma separated list of Gracenote artist type descriptorIDs for filtering results (max 5)

languageIDs.name: languageIDs
languageIDs.description: Comma separated list of Gracenote language descriptorIDs for filtering results (max 5)

moodIDs.name: moodIDs
moodIDs.description: Comma separated list of Gracenote mood descriptorIDs for filtering results (max 5)

tempoIDs.name: tempoIDs
tempoIDs.description: Comma separated list of Gracenote tempo descriptorIDs for filtering results (max 5)

styleIDs.name: styleIDs
styleIDs.description: Comma separated list of Gracenote style descriptorIDs for filtering results (max 5)

artistIDs.name: artistIDs
artistIDs.description: Comma separated list of Gracenote artist IDs for filtering results (max 5)

tmsIDs.name: tmsIDs
tmsIDs.description:
Comma-separated TMS IDs (max 100). TMS stands for Tribune Media Services —
these IDs tie an album to a specific film or TV program. You'll need the
`tms-id` add-on enabled on your API key.

includeRelatedArtists.name: includeRelatedArtists
includeRelatedArtists.description:
Comma separated list of related artist types to include in the result set. Must be used with an input artistID.

If you specify `includeRelatedArtists`, in addition to results where the input artistID is the artist, you will get objects that match according to the following rules:

`memberOfKeyArtists` will include will include results matching the artists in the input artistID's memberOfKeyArtists array
      (i.e. if given Prince, return albums by Prince & The Revolution)

`memberOfGroups` will include results matching the artists in the input artistID's memberOfGroups array

`memberOfCollaborations` will include results matching the artists in the input artistID's memberOfCollaborations array

`similarArtists` will include results matching the artists in the input artistID's similarArtists array

`omitSeedArtists` will omit results matching the input artistID(s)

limit.name: limit
limit.description: Limit the number of results between 1 and 25.

offset.name: offset
offset.description: Return results starting at the given offset. Used for paging through results. Maximum value is 25000

icpn.name: icpn
icpn.description: Include ICPN in search criteria. Supported codes include UPCs, EANs and others.

albumSearchRecordingName.name: recordingName
albumSearchRecordingName.description: A recording name that appears on the album edition you are trying to match.

videoMusicReleaseType.name: videoMusicReleaseType
videoMusicReleaseType.description:
Filter by one or more video music release types. Pass a single value or a comma-separated list (e.g. `score,soundtrack`).
When omitted, no filtering is applied and rows with any value (including null/empty) are returned.

displayLanguage.name: displayLanguage
displayLanguage.description: Specify the language for descriptor label localization in the response.

genreList.name: genreList
genreList.description: Select a genre hierarchy List according to the desired region and specificity. This parameter is only supported for Customers with GMD Discovery/Advanced Discovery package.

descriptorList.name: descriptorList
descriptorList.description:
Specify the descriptor hierarchy to retrieve. 

**For genres:** Must use exact hierarchy labels (e.g., GENRES-US-SIMPLIFIED, GENRES-US-DETAILED)

**For other types:** Can use simple descriptor type name:
- LANGUAGES
- ORIGINS
- ERAS
- ARTISTTYPES
- MOODS
- STYLES
- TEMPOS

level.name: level
level.description:
Filter hierarchy data by specific level. 

When provided, only nodes at the specified level will be returned.
If not provided, the complete hierarchy tree is returned.

**Note:** Only descriptor types with data at the requested level will return results.

apiKeyParam.name: GN-APIKEY
apiKeyParam.description: API key to authorize the request.

genreList.description: Hierarchical Genre List used for response.

descriptors.description: Descriptor data is only returned to Customers with GMD Discovery/Advanced Discovery package.

disambiguation.description: A short display string intended to aid in disambiguating similarly named artists. Currently this is in English only and is only visible to Customers with GMD Search package and above

images.description: An array of the images for the artist. Returns one classic image with one size (largest available), selected by hierarchy: Preferred > Latest Promotional > Latest In Performance > Latest Red Carpet. Enhanced images (headshot, iconic, backdrop) are included when artist-enhanced-image add-on is present. The first entry is the preferred image. Only visible to Customers with Artist Images add-on

nameVariants.description: Name Variants can include full name, birth names, misspellings, nicknames, etc. Only visible to Customers with GMD Search package and above.

personIDs.description: GN TMS Person IDs associated with Artist. Only visible to Customers with Links to GN TMS Person ID Add On

groupMembers.description: For `group` artist objects, the artists that are or have been members of the group. Only visible to Customers with GMD Search package and above

collaborationMembers.description: For `collaboration` artist objects, the artists that are part of the collaboration. Only visible to Customers with GMD Search package and above

keyArtists.description: For `group` artist objects that have them, this will be the key group members (for example, Prince is the key artist in Prince & The Revolution. if Only visible to Customers with GMD Search package and above

memberOfKeyArtists.description: For artists that are or have been a key artist in groups, this will be the list of groups that they were a key artist in. Only visible to Customers with GMD Search package and above

memberOfGroups.description: For artists that are or have been members of groups, this will be the list of groups they were members of. Only visible to Customers with GMD Search package and above

memberOfCollaborations.description: For artists that are or have been members of collaborations, this will be the list of collaborations they were members of. Only visible to Customers with GMD Search package and above

similarArtists.description: Only visible to Customers with GMD Advanced Discovery Package

sortName.description: The sortable version of the artist's name.

submittedArtistID.description: The Gracenote Artist ID as submitted in the API request. Populated when a GNID lookup or explore filtered by artistIDs returns this entity. Null for search and non-GNID lookups.

industryCodes.description: Album release codes such as ICPN. Only visible to Customers with Partner IDs add-on

images.description: An array of the images for the album edition. Returns one image with one size (largest available). The first entry is the preferred image. Only visible to Customers with Cover Art add-on

releaseType.description: Only visible to Customers with GMD Discovery/Advanced Discovery package and above

releaseYear.description: Only visible to Customers with GMD Search package

selectedAlbumEditionID.description: It is the selected Album Edition for this album grouping. Only visible to Customers with GMD Search package

submittedAlbumEditionID.description: The Gracenote Album Edition ID as submitted in the API request. Populated when a GNID lookup returns this entity. Null for search, non-GNID lookups, and explore endpoints.

submittedArtistID.description: The Gracenote Artist ID as submitted in the API request. Populated when an explore endpoint filtered by artistIDs returns this entity. Null for lookup and search endpoints.

releaseDate.description: The raw release date string of the album edition as provided by the source.

label.description: The record label associated with the album edition as provided by the source.

AlbumMasterEditionItem.title: album master edition item
AlbumMasterEditionItem.description: Short reference to one edition inside an Album Master.

isSelectedAlbumEdition.description:
`true` for the one edition Gracenote picked as the default.
Only one item per master will be `true`.

AlbumMasterObject.title: album master object
AlbumMasterObject.description:
One entry per logical album. Groups together all the remastered, deluxe,
and regional editions under a single ID so you don't have to de-dupe them yourself.

albumMasterID.description: Unique Gracenote ID for this album grouping.

albumMasterName.description: Display name for the album, usually taken from the preferred edition.

descriptors.description:
Genre data only — moods, tempos, and styles live on the individual Recordings.
Requires GMD Discovery or Advanced Discovery package.

preferredEditionID.description:
Points to the edition Gracenote considers the best default pick.
Will be `null` if no preferred edition has been assigned yet.
Matches the item in `allAlbumEditions` where `isSelectedAlbumEdition` is `true`.

releaseType.description:
What kind of release this is. Requires GMD Discovery/Advanced Discovery.

Note: you might see `unclassified` in responses, but you can't filter on it
— the `releaseTypes` query param won't accept it.

releaseYear.description: Year the album came out. Requires GMD Search package.

allAlbumEditions.description:
Every edition we know about for this album. Check `isSelectedAlbumEdition`
on each item to find the preferred one.

externalIDs.description: Partner catalog IDs (Spotify, Apple, etc.). Requires Partner IDs add-on.

images.description:
Cover art pulled from the preferred edition. You'll get an empty array
if there's no preferred edition set. Requires Cover Art add-on.

videoMusicReleaseType.description: `soundtrack`, `score`, or `null` if the album isn't tied to film/TV.

submittedArtistID.description: Echoes back the artistID you filtered on. Null when the request wasn't filtered by artist.

addOns.description: Add Ons licensed to the user's API Key.

packages.description: Packages licensed to the user's API Key.

TrackObject.title: track object

industryCodes.description: Track release codes such as ISRCs. Only visible to Customers with Partner IDs add-on

descriptors.description: Moods and Tempos are only visible to Customers with GMD Discovery/Advanced Discovery package. While Styles is only available with Styles add-on

ord.description: Group members are ordered according to their relevance.

images.description: An array of the images for the artist. Returns one classic image with one size (largest available), selected by hierarchy: Preferred > Latest Promotional > Latest In Performance > Latest Red Carpet. Enhanced images (headshot, iconic, backdrop) are included when artist-enhanced-image add-on is present. The first entry is the preferred image. Only visible to Customers with Artist Images add-on

PopularityData.title: popularity data
PopularityData.description:
Popularity score is on a scale of 0 to 1, with a resolution out to 5 decimal places, which is derived
from a proprietary blend of signals and indicates the relative All-Time, or Recent popularity of Artists
and Recordings.
Only visible to Customers with Popularity Add On

languageContext.description: The language contexts of the name. Only visible to Customers with GMD Discovery/Advanced Discovery package and above
The language contexts of the name. Only visible to Customers with GMD Discovery/Advanced Discovery package and above

imageType.description: Image type identifier. Classic artist images: artistImage-promotional, artistImage-inPerformance, artistImage-redCarpet, artistImage-other. Enhanced artist images: artistImage-headshot, artistImage-iconic, artistImage-backdrop. Album images: coverArt.

preferred.description: Indicates if this is a preferred image. Only present for classic artist images. Values: 'true' or 'false'.

total.description: Total number of hierarchy nodes returned

descriptorList.description: The descriptor hierarchy that was requested

displayLanguage.description: The display language used for labels

children.description: Child nodes in the hierarchy (only present for hierarchical data)

IndustryCode.title: industry code
IndustryCode.description: Industry codes like ISRCs and ICPNs.
